notes.title: Steam Deck verified and further improvements.
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we hope you're having a great weekend! 

Some of you may have noticed recent patch notes mentioning various font size fixes throughout the game. That’s because we've been making sure the font is legible across the board - and meets certification standards for the Steam Deck. As a result we're thrilled to announce that [i]Yes, Your Grace 2: Snowfall[/i] is now: 
[h1][b]Steam Deck Verified[/b]![/h1]

We're continuing to improve the game. Recently, we increased the difficulty in Chapter 2 after noticing many of you felt it wasn't challenging enough. We've also removed the reset of resources between chapters - we understand that was frustrating for some of you.

On top of that, we're actively working on the Mac version of the game. If you're using an Apple computer, keep an eye out as we will have news for you very soon!

As always, thank you all for the continued support. We read your comments and reviews, and take your feedback on board! If you haven’t left a review yet, please consider doing so - it helps us more than you know!

Yours,
Brave Team x

notes.title: Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall Dev Stream Incoming!
notes.content:
[h1]Happy New Year Gamers!!! 🤩[/h1]

It’s 2024 😲 this means we are so much closer to the Snowfall launch! We cannot wait to share the rest of the game with you and see your reactions to it *(we’re all secretly hoping you’re going to sob your eyes out when you find out what we did to your favourite characters <evil laugh>)*

Snowfall Beta took us by surprise a little bit, we have received much more feedback than anticipated so if you’ve participated in it thank you so much <3 we’re very thankful to have such an amazing and active community of *potato-heads* helping us make this game.

We have been very busy working through your feedback and we’re so close 🤏 to being back on track after implementing the most important changes.

[h1]Brand New Input System[/h1]

Whoop whoop! The most requested feature was the ability to change how you control the game and it’s almost done! You will now be able to play the game with keyboard only/mouse only or a combination of both (or a controller!).

[h1]Audry is back ✨[/h1]

Depending on the decisions you made in Yes, Your Grace, you will either be assigned a brand new Advisor, or be reunited with your most trusted family friend.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/b65735e3b4d06e92e02461d9a10c8daaf34bea9c.gif[/img]

[h1]New story flow 🤫[/h1]

We have revisited some character arcs in Chapter 1, shortened the whole chapter to make it more cohesive and improve the flow! There has been some exciting changes but we will leave it for you to discover for yourself *soon*!

[h1]Waka waka[/h1]

I’m happy to report that 90% of the cast now has a voice 🗣️ We’re still working on polishing them up, but you were right!! The characters feel 100% more alive and emotional now *(you asked for it, don’t blame us if they make you cry now).*

Aside from aaaaaall of the above, we have brand new animations, redesigned how threat events work in the game, wrote a lot of new dialogues for the remaining chapters and changed how the Yes, Your Grace decisions will be imported into the game (more info on that later) ✨

I think it’s safe to say we’ve had a VERY busy past few months! 🔥🥵🔥

[h2]That’s not all 😲[/h2]

We have a couple of exciting announcements to share with you as well:

[h1]Yes, Your Grace is coming to mobiles THIS WEEK!![/h1]

We have partnered with Noodlecake to bring Yes, Your Grace to Android and IOS on February 1st 🎉

We have been working on this in secret for a very long time so we hope you enjoy playing through the story again *(or for the first time!)* on your phone ✨

- The first hour of the game is free to play
- The game will cost $4.99
- 20% discount will apply during the launch week

Get it on AppStore or Google Play Store!


[h1] Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall ❄️ award nomination[/h1]

Our game was nominated for *“Most anticipated game”* award at the DEBUG awards 😭🥺

It means so much to us that so many of you are patiently awaiting the release of the game so thank you! If you would like Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall to win the award, you can vote for us here: https://www.teamdebug.com/awards/vote


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/17aebb12513b0efea275f4767822f60c870634c0.png[/img]

[h1]Story Tellers Festival 📖🤓📖[/h1]

We are coming to the Story Tellers Festival to celebrate amazing stories told through the medium of games! 

We absolutely love to discover new story-driven games so if you do too, come find us at the fest alongside other awesome games <3

As a part of the festival we will be doing a DEV STREAM of Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall 😲 so if you would like a small 🤏 peek of the changes we have implemented since beta, come along to the store page on January 30th at 6pm GMT. 

To remember, you can set a reminder by pressing the ‘Remind Me’ button on the right side of this news (or add it to your calendar) 🙏 We hope to see you there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/68c4c12b9ee05984bf1d14eb0881a71afe82fd99.png[/img]

Here is to awesome 2024 🎉 🍾

Stay Brave xx

notes.title: Development Update #2 - Are we switching engines?
notes.content:
A very exciting progress update on Snowfall this month! Read on to get a little sneak peak of some new animations, concept art and plans for the future!

As our team prepares for the Autumn months and we work comfortably wrapped in cosy blankets, we are getting ready to release a Beta build for all of you to try very soon. Keep an eye on the news here for updates! The Beta version will allow you to play through the first hour of the game, featuring random queue quests, new characters and our brand new management mechanics. We're excited to hear your feedback on these new systems! <3

In the past month we have organised a little field trip to the castle that inspired it all - Malbork castle in Gdansk.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/994d2885b582141852f5d500ec24872f01e762a5.jpg[/img]

We have gathered some interesting textures, stories and historical facts to help us make the game even more interesting! - Did you know the castle, built in 1400s, had underfloor heating?!


In the meantime, the team has been diligently working on a chapter system. Have been writing captivating main storyline dialogues for chapter III, and also putting a lot of effort effort towards creating numerous new animations that will enhance the overall visual experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/0808ddcd3af5f7e10b566f88f9e813149244afcd.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/0fb4f15748b5861231dd00b0a259c61779d77bfd.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/c08db1174a8008f6b03c3ed9589aa41aabbef7c8.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/21f32cd0b73f719eda60cb0c5a7389823a3376b4.gif[/img]

We also have some lovely concept art pieces for new scenes and some that are already in game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/21d7f499c7e4147ab0b659e9c345b7738c0e6b09.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/87d9e4ee9014a0c007a476181f7e22055e7d429f.jpg[/img]

I'm thrilled to share that the development of the game is going at a fantastic pace right now, and I couldn't be happier to inform you that we are not only meeting but also surpassing all of our milestones and marketing goals. We've been making remarkable progress, and I'm excited to announce that next month is going to be jam-packed with exciting updates. Get ready for new reveals, a fresh and revamped UI, and an epic new trailer that will surely blow you away!

[h2]Unity, Unity, Unity🙄[/h2]

Game development never goes smoothly, and this time is no exception. We have encountered several challenges along the way. Recently, the game engine we use, Unity, announced significant changes to their pricing structure. In addition to the monthly fee, we may also have to pay additional fees based on the number of game installs after a certain threshold. This will have an impact on both Yes, Your Grace and Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall, especially if we decide to participate in subscription-based or charity programs on various platforms. These programs can greatly increase the number of game installs.

We have had numerous discussions in the studio this week, and while we are disappointed with Unity's decisions, we are too far into development to switch engines. Doing so would result in major release delays. We have dedicated years to building our own development workflows and tools around Unity, so this is not a decision we take lightly. However, for future projects, we are likely to explore different game engines.


If you haven’t already, add the game to your wishlist and if you are enjoying these development updates make sure to click that thumbs up button <3



https://store.steampowered.com/app/1373090/Yes_Your_Grace_Snowfall/
